copy.headline: These are the 14 best things to do in Fort Worth this weekend
copy.caption: The weekend before Thanksgiving brings lots of holiday events in and around Fort Worth, including an ice skating rink, a theater production, a large market, a light display, a concert, fun in a theme park, and a parade. Other choices include a tribute to a Rat Packer, screenings of an acclaimed new film, a symphony concert, three country concerts, and a women's basketball showcase.
